_comment: Clip chosen: GasVid MOV_2566 (via Lang-Gas), converted mp4v -> H.264 with avconvert, then cropped to 03:10-08:00 of the original (source_segment). Licence still unconfirmed, so status stays pending. resolution/frame_rate/duration_s/frame_count are written by scripts/ogi_inspect.py. Fill from the approved METEC/GasVid clip after inspecting the file (ffprobe). Clip goes in data/ogi/source_clip.mp4 (not committed). detection_mode is one of: external_detector_alert, local_model_inference, recorded_model_output, manually_annotated_replay. frame_rate is a number (fps); resolution like "640x480".
